prompts.prompt: In Amazon Redshift Serverless, what is the minimum billing duration in seconds charged per query, regardless of how quickly the query actually finishes? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/redshift/references/architecture.md - Redshift Serverless Architecture > Auto-Scaling Behavior: billed only for RPU-seconds consumed, with a minimum of 60 seconds per query

prompts.prompt: How many free hours of Redshift concurrency scaling credit does a cluster earn per 24-hour period that it is active? Answer with the exact number.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/redshift/references/architecture.md - Concurrency Scaling: each cluster earns up to 1 hour of free concurrency scaling credits per day for every 24 hours it is active (also stated in best-practices.md Cost Optimization)

prompts.prompt: In Amazon Redshift's columnar storage engine, what is the fixed size of each immutable block that a column's data is broken into on disk? Answer with the exact size.
prompts.source: plugins/database/skills/redshift/references/architecture.md and SKILL.md - Columnar Storage Engine: each column stored in a sequence of immutable 1 MB blocks
